name: AG1 (Athletic Greens)

price: About $79/mo on subscription for the pouch; travel packs about $89/mo subscribed or $109 one-time for 30 (third-party reviews, barbend.com / garagegymreviews.com; drinkag1.com returned 429, so unverified). A Grüns reviewer reported paying $94/mo.
